prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one portrait low-fidelity UX sketch for a shoelaundry cashier mobile app, 3:4 aspect, representing focused Detail Pesanan component 390x520 logical size, no phone/device bezel, no OS. One design, not a collage. White background, black and gray only. Slightly handdrawn rectangular boxes, with exceptionally clear large printed Indonesian text. No colors.
Reference image 1 is contextual research only: existing payment record information; not a style/layout template. Do not reproduce blue/green/orange or Rp57.000.
Concept: guided three-stage stepper inside ONE canonical Detail Pesanan. Header 'Detail Pesanan'; next line 'PSN-015 | Bank Transfer | Rp150.000'. Across top show three connected step circles: '1 Data', '2 Pemeriksaan', '3 Keputusan'. Second stage visibly active; first complete; third future, no extra pages. A compact top strip 'Pembayaran tercatat' / 'Bukan konfirmasi dana masuk'. Main central stage card title 'Pemeriksaan', large status 'Menunggu hasil', 'Pemeriksa: Owner', 'Hasil belum tersedia'. One large outlined primary button 'Lihat permintaan'. Small textual link 'Panduan saat menunggu'. Beneath card a clear inactive light gray 'Keputusan / Teruskan' button with reason 'Hasil memadai belum tersedia'. Bottom navigation 'Kembali ke Data' at left and 'Keluar sementara' at right; these preserve same order context. Small 'Data ilustrasi' at very bottom. Main visual model clearly a horizontal stepper and single active stage, NOT accordion, NOT timeline, NOT comparison. No option number or design title, no branding. Generous white space, few short blocks, readable large text. No bank access, no fund approval by admin, no automatic integration, no ETA or result while waiting.
qa: Inspected inline; label spelling accurate; 3 stages Data/Pemeriksaan/Keputusan visible, current middle stage; waiting result distinct from recorded payment; inactive Teruskan, help and return preserved.
